cardamom.name: Large cardamom (alaichi)
cardamom.sub: Nepal is the world's largest producer of large (black) cardamom — here's the trade picture and how to ship it.
cardamom.body:
About the product

Large cardamom (Amomum subulatum), known locally as alaichi, is grown in Nepal's eastern hill districts — Taplejung, Panchthar, Ilam and Sankhuwasabha. Nepal is the world's top producer, and cardamom is one of its highest-value agricultural exports.

Nepal's position

Almost all of Nepal's crop goes to India, which both consumes it and re-exports onward to the Middle East and beyond. Because the market is so India-concentrated, prices swing with Indian demand and with how the India–Nepal trade treaty treats the product in a given year — a key risk for growers and exporters.

How to export from Nepal

  1. Register for an EXIM code with the Department of Customs (one-time exporter registration).
  2. Phytosanitary certificate from the National Plant Quarantine Program — required for agricultural produce.
  3. Certificate of origin from a recognised chamber of commerce or TEPC (a SAARC/SAFTA certificate for shipments to India).
  4. Grading & quality to the buyer's specification (moisture, size, cleanliness).
  5. File the export declaration in the customs system and clear at the border/dry port.

Agro exports may qualify for the government's cash export-incentive scheme; rates are set in the annual budget, so confirm the current figure with TEPC before you price a shipment.
cardamom.sources: Trade & Export Promotion Centre (tepc.gov.np), Nepal Trade Information Portal (nepaltradeportal.gov.np), Department of Customs (customs.gov.np), National Plant Quarantine Program.

carpets.name: Hand-knotted woollen carpets
carpets.h1: Exporting hand-knotted woollen carpets from Nepal
carpets.sub: Nepal's signature manufactured export — here's who buys it and how to ship it.
carpets.body:
About the product

Hand-knotted Tibetan–Nepali woollen carpets are made around the Kathmandu Valley (Jawalakhel, Boudha, Sankhu). They are a flagship manufactured export and one of the country's larger formal-sector employers.

Nepal's position

The United States is Nepal's largest carpet market, followed by Germany, the UK and other EU countries. Western buyers increasingly require child-labour-free certification (GoodWeave), so that certification is effectively part of market access.

How to export from Nepal

  1. Register for an EXIM code with the Department of Customs.
  2. Certificate of origin from a chamber or TEPC; a GSP Form A where the destination grants Nepal preferential access (eligibility varies by country — confirm the current status before quoting duty-free).
  3. GoodWeave / quality certification, valued or required by most Western importers.
  4. File the export declaration and clear through customs (usually air or sea freight via Kolkata/Haldia).

Manufactured exports may qualify for the government's cash export-incentive scheme — check the current rate with TEPC, as it is reset annually.
carpets.sources: Nepal Carpet Exporters' Association, Trade & Export Promotion Centre (tepc.gov.np), Department of Customs (customs.gov.np), Nepal Trade Information Portal (nepaltradeportal.gov.np).
